card.name: Comma after a missed-dose condition
card.fires_on: The comma that ends an "if a dose is missed" clause, right before the instruction on what to do. It appears in missed-dose sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Drug name then comma
modes.description: Comma after a missed-dose clause that names the drug.
modes.example: In the case of a missed dose of TAVALISSE<<,>> instruct patients to take their next dose at

modes.label: Generic missed-dose clause
modes.description: Comma after a clause that says a dose is missed or not taken on time, with no drug name.
modes.example: 2.7 Missed Doses If a dose is missed<<,>> administer the dose as soon as possible.
